flavor: refine (design the two-half architecture; design-it-twice the load-bearing novel interfaces)

c0-frame.title: Frame cycle 3
c0-frame.imperative: Human: 'continue on the design' + guard the OTHER half (neuter internal jargon). Refine: harden one direction into a design, holding BOTH halves. Design-it-twice the load-bearing novel interfaces per tier standard.

q1-spine.title: Spine check: two halves (teach real-world / neuter internal) over one shared concept ledger
q1-spine.imperative: Present the unifying spine — two opposite policies over one per-concept ledger (real-world/internal tag + familiarity) — and confirm it lands with the human before detailing. Coming-along-for-the-ride: don't build the big ball; check the organizing idea first.
q1-spine.finding: Human confirmed the spine: 'yeah I think that's it'. Two policies over one ledger, locked.

x5-dit.title: Design-it-twice: shared-understanding mechanism (panel of 4)
x5-dit.imperative: Panel of 4 (A minimal / B map-overlay / C tutor-service / D distributed), verified fresh. Opinionated recommendation below; convergence is the human's.
x5-dit.finding: RECOMMENDATION = a named HYBRID, not any single candidate. Core = D's append-only observation log + derived legible view (solves the 2 hazards the human flagged: concurrency dissolves via commuting appends; context-load via keyed lookup — query only the 0-3 terms in THIS message, never preload a dictionary), riding A's existing-artifact home (docs/agents/, zero new load path) instead of a new dir. Expose it through C's typed pure-function verbs (familiarity/unlocked/observe) as a <=1-screen shared helper — NOT a running service (rejecting C-as-service: highest heavy-machinery risk = the near-kill anti-goal; plus latency + a failure matrix only it needs; C itself admits 'wins iff the 2nd caller is real'). Policies applied INLINE per every agent (D + confirmed T-A) under A's short interleaving contract. Tutor = summon-only escalation on miss/pushback (all 4 agree). GRAFT B's reconcile-decay (familiarity softens when the code/map moves) as an OPTIONAL enhancement where a map exists — B's best idea without its fatal map-dependency. Curator jargon-lint (K8) reads the shared unlocked() predicate = the backstop for the 'in-flow chat enforced by nothing' hole. B rejected as primary: structurally serves Half B (internal jargon — the half the human cares about MORE) the WORST, and dies on map-less projects (f1brainz + most). THE ONE BIGGEST OPEN RISK, punted as a scoped null by ALL FOUR: the calibration classifier — deciding 'fluent use vs stumble' from free prose. It is also the crux of D's judgment-drift wound. Drive it down next (tight pinned rubric + worked examples; possibly the one thing worth standardizing centrally even while policies stay distributed).

consolidation.summary: Cycle 3 (refine / design-it-twice) consolidated. Spine confirmed by human. Panel of 4 designs (A/B/C/D) verified fresh. Axis scores: A minimal — wins heavy-machinery-avoidance + locality + symmetric halves; loses depth (pedagogy is a discipline in every agent, no test seam for interleaving; in-flow chat enforced by nothing) and hand-waves concurrency + context-load. B map-overlay — wins testability + reconcile-decay (knowledge decays when code changes); FAILS serve-both-halves (internal jargon mostly not on the map = the half the human cares about MORE served WORST) and is parasitic on a map most projects lack. C tutor-service — wins depth + testability + halves-cannot-drift (methods on one field) + central expertise-reversal; loses hardest on heavy-machinery (a service+store = the near-kill anti-goal), latency, a failure matrix only it needs, silent-no-op coupling; admits 'wins iff 2nd caller real'. D distributed — solves both hazards the human flagged (concurrency via append-only commuting log; context-load via keyed lookup), lowest condescension, most balanced halves (no tutor-gravity toward teach); loses locality (fans out to every agent) and carries the judgment-drift wound.
consolidation.recommendation: Named HYBRID: D's append-only ledger + derived legible view, home per A (docs/agents/, zero new load path), exposed via C's typed pure-function verbs as a tiny shared helper (NOT a service), policies inline per D/A, tutor summon-only, reconcile-decay grafted from B where a map exists, curator-lint on unlocked() as the persisted-surface backstop.
consolidation.biggest_open_risk: The calibration classifier (fluent-use vs stumble from free prose) — punted as a scoped null by ALL FOUR designs, and the crux of D's drift wound. Standardize it tightly (pinned rubric + worked examples) even while policy application stays distributed.
consolidation.next_move: human's call — NOT converging. Options: accept/modify the hybrid as the design direction; push the classifier risk (a prototype or a 5th design-it-twice on just the classifier); or say ready-for-spec.
